infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow camera access only when you choose to capture a photo or video on YouTube.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow microphone access only when you choose to record on YouTube.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo or video to share on YouTube.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save a file when you choose to download it from YouTube.
